//: A SHIELD RAISED (Mob::StepShield, item.h ShieldSpec::clip): the shield arm brought up with the forearm across the chest, the shield upright and facing forward in front of the sternum. Authored for a shield in the RIGHT fist; the left plays the derived .mirror. The engine sets this clip's WEIGHT to the raise fraction every tick (restFill: weight w is w of the way from rest to the key), so the arm is exactly as far up as the mechanics say at whatever speed the shield comes up; no blend-in for that reason. pitchFollow lifts and tilts the shield with the look. Solved by scripts/gen_shield_clips.py from targets -- edit them there and re-run, never these quaternions.
name: shield_raise
